needs_atom.missing: A trigger-cause axis on AbilityTriggerEvent: 'If a permanent entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time' (Panharmonicon family, CR 603.2) applies only to triggers whose triggering event is a permanent entering the battlefield. AbilityTriggerEvent(filter) reads only the triggering ability's SOURCE permanent (binding._fan_ability_triggers), and no condition predicate reads the triggering event, so the Sanctum of All shape (AbilityTriggerEvent(CONTROLLER_IS YOU) -> TRIGGER_ADDITIONAL 1) would double every trigger of every permanent you control (attacks, upkeep, dies...): stronger than printed. Needs e.g. AbilityTriggerEvent.cause: an EventSpec the original triggering event must match (ZoneChangeEvent to the battlefield, any permanent). Deathtouch and lifelink are compiled.
